en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square with a large domed former mosque/church building, stepped terraces with a fountain, and surrounding historic buildings. One façade bears the sign 'NÁDOR SZÁLLÓ'. People are walking and sitting around the square, and mid‑20th‑century cars are parked on cobbled streets. The reverse side has printed Hungarian text identifying the location as 'PÉCS Széchenyi tér', handwritten greetings in blue ink, a Hungarian 'Magyar Posta' tram stamp (20 Ft), and an address in Budapest.
